title: Jeremiah 42
paragraphs: ¹ Then all the military commanders — Johanan son of Kareah, Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least to the greatest — came forward ² and said to Jeremiah the prophet, "Please hear our request and pray to the LORD your God for this whole remnant, because as you can see, only a few of us remain out of many. ³ Ask the LORD your God to show us the way we should go and what we should do." ⁴ Jeremiah the prophet answered them, "I hear you. I will pray to the LORD your God as you ask, and I will tell you everything he says — I will hold nothing back from you." ⁵ Then they said to Jeremiah, "May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we don't act according to everything the LORD your God sends you to tell us."

⁶ "Whether it is good or bad, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God to whom we are sending you, so that things will go well for us when we obey him." ⁷ Ten days later the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah. ⁸ He summoned Johanan son of Kareah, all the military commanders with him, and all the people from the least to the greatest, ⁹ and said to them, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says — the God to whom you sent me to bring your request: ¹⁰ If you will stay in this land, I will build you up and not tear you down; I will plant you and not uproot you, because I relent over the disaster I have brought on you."

¹¹ "Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you now fear — do not be afraid of him, declares the LORD, for I am with you to save you and deliver you from his grip. ¹² I will show you compassion, and he will have mercy on you and let you return to your own land. ¹³ But if you say, 'We will not stay in this land' — and so refuse to obey the voice of the LORD your God — ¹⁴ and say instead, 'No, we will go to Egypt, where we will see no war, hear no trumpet, and go hungry for no bread — that is where we will live': ¹⁵ then hear the word of the LORD, you remnant of Judah. This is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: If you are determined to go to Egypt and settle there,"

¹⁶ then the sword you fear will catch up with you there in Egypt, and the famine you dread will follow you there, and you will die in Egypt. ¹⁷ All who are determined to go to Egypt to settle there will die by the sword, famine, and plague — not one of them will survive or escape the disaster I will bring upon them. ¹⁸ For this is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Just as my anger and wrath were poured out on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so my wrath will be poured out on you when you go to Egypt. You will become an object of cursing and horror, a byword and a disgrace, and you will never see this place again. ¹⁹ The LORD has spoken concerning you, remnant of Judah: Do not go to Egypt. Know for certain that I have warned you today. ²⁰ You were being deceptive when you sent me to the LORD your God, saying, 'Pray to the LORD our God for us; tell us everything he says and we will do it.'

²¹ Today I have told you, but you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God — not in anything he sent me to tell you. ²² So know for certain that you will die by the sword, famine, and plague in the place where you want to go and settle.
